items.title: Alison dos Santos vence 400 metros com barreiras no Mundial de Atletismo Ultimate
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O detentor do recorde mundial dos 400 metros com barreiras, o brasileiro Alison dos Santos, venceu a prova na última noite do primeiro Campeonato Mundial de Atletismo Ultimate, neste domingo em Budapeste.
items.body:
O detentor do recorde mundial dos 400 metros com barreiras, o brasileiro Alison dos Santos, venceu a prova na última noite do primeiro Campeonato Mundial de Atletismo Ultimate, neste domingo em Budapeste.
Após estabelecer o recorde mundial da prova há duas semanas, o brasileiro marcou 45,98 segundos e derrotou os rivais Rai Benjamin, dos EUA (46,40), e o ex-recordista Karsten Warholm, da Noruega (46,78).
Jasmine Jones, dos EUA, venceu a prova feminina com o tempo de 52,45.
A primeira edição do Mundial de Atletismo Ultimate contou com um prêmio total de US$10 milhões, o maior da história do esporte. Mais de 60 mil torcedores compareceram aos três dias de eventos com ingressos esgotados em Budapeste.
(Reportagem de Lori Ewing)

items.title: El brasileño Alison dos Santos vuelve a brillar con triunfo en 400 metros con vallas en Budapest
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El plusmarquista mundial Alison dos Santos se impuso en los 400 metros con vallas masculinos, mientras que Djamel Sedjati se alzó como ganador sorpresa de los 800 metros masculinos en la última noche del primer Campeonato Mundial de Atletismo Ultimate, celebrado el domingo.
items.body:
El plusmarquista mundial Alison dos Santos se impuso en los 400 metros con vallas masculinos, mientras que Djamel Sedjati se alzó como ganador sorpresa de los 800 metros masculinos en la última noche del primer Campeonato Mundial de Atletismo Ultimate, celebrado el domingo.
El brasileño dos Santos, que batió el récord mundial hace dos semanas, registró un tiempo de 45,98 segundos para superar a sus rivales Rai Benjamin, de Estados Unidos, con 46,40, y al antiguo plusmarquista Karsten Warholm, de Noruega, con 46,78. Jasmine Jones, de Estados Unidos, se impuso en la prueba femenina con un tiempo de 52,45.
El argelino Sedjati superó al canadiense Marco Arop, campeón del mundo de 2023, en los últimos pasos para ganar los 800 metros masculinos con un tiempo de 1:41,91. Arop cruzó la meta en 1:42,28, mientras que el campeón olímpico keniano Emmanuel Wanyonyi quedó tercero, con 1:42,44.
Rumesh Pathirage, de Sri Lanka, lanzó a 91,09 metros y se impuso en la prueba masculina de lanzamiento de jabalina con una ventaja de casi cinco metros.
La etíope Likina Amebaw se escapó del pelotón para ganar una carrera táctica de los 5.000 metros femeninos con un tiempo de 14:30,36.
La primera edición del Ultimate Championship contó con una bolsa de premios de 10 millones de dólares, la mayor de la historia de este deporte. Más de 60.000 aficionados asistieron a las tres jornadas con entradas agotadas en Budapest.

items.title: Ravens WR Zay Flowers' 150-yard first half ends with hamstring injury
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Baltimore Ravens wide receiver Zay Flowers set a career high with 150 receiving yards in the first half at Indianapolis on Sunday but went to the bench with a hamstring injury with six minutes left in the second quarter.
items.body:
Baltimore Ravens wide receiver Zay Flowers set a career high with 150 receiving yards in the first half at Indianapolis on Sunday but went to the bench with a hamstring injury with six minutes left in the second quarter.
Baltimore announced Flowers was questionable to return to the game, after he torched the Colts for multiple huge plays.
Flowers caught a 49-yard pass from Lamar Jackson on the Ravens' first offensive play of the game to set up a 5-yard Jackson TD run.
Flowers left the Colts in the dust on a 54-yard touchdown in the second quarter. Flowers crossed the field from the left in front of Jackson 4 yards from the line of scrimmage, caught a sidearm throw, turned upfield and burst through a line of chasing defenders. It was his fourth catch for 138 yards with more than six minutes left in the second quarter.
On his fifth grab, Flowers was quickly corralled by Colts cornerback Sauce Gardner and sat on the turf for a few seconds, rubbing the back of his left leg.
Ravens cornerback T.J. Tampa left the game in the first quarter with a knee injury.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Report: Maxx Crosby turned down Rams' trade interest
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Maxx Crosby made it known to teams looking to trade for him after a move to the Baltimore Ravens fell through last March that he only wanted to play for the Las Vegas Raiders, NFL Network reported Sunday.
items.body:
Maxx Crosby made it known to teams looking to trade for him after a move to the Baltimore Ravens fell through last March that he only wanted to play for the Las Vegas Raiders, NFL Network reported Sunday.
Those interested teams, according to the network's sources, included the Los Angeles Rams, who eventually pivoted to a trade with the Cleveland Browns for five-time All-Pro Myles Garrett. The Philadelphia Eagles, Dallas Cowboys and San Francisco 49ers also checked in on Crosby, one of the NFL's top edge rushers.
Crosby was expected to be a Raven last spring once Baltimore agreed to send Las Vegas a package led by two first-round draft picks, but the Ravens backed out over concerns about Crosby's knee. Once that decision became public, other clubs wanted to snag the five-time Pro Bowler for what was described to NFL Network as "pennies on the dollars."
Crosby, for his part, posted on social media that "I'm a Raider. I'm back."
The Raiders shut down Crosby for the final two games last season, citing a knee injury. Crosby's displeasure over that move made it appear as if a split would happen in the offseason. Indeed, the deal with the Ravens seemed to confirm a disconnect.
But Crosby now appears to be happy in Las Vegas and is active for the Raiders' Week 1 game against the Miami Dolphins. He enters the 2026 season with 69.5 sacks in 110 career games, all with the Raiders, who drafted him in the fourth round of the 2019 NFL Draft out of Eastern Michigan.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Cyclisme-L'Espagnol Mas remporte la Vuelta, son premier Grand Tour
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: L'Espagnol Enric Mas a remporté dimanche la Vuelta, signant sa première victoire dans un Grand Tour.
items.body:
L'Espagnol Enric Mas a remporté dimanche la Vuelta, signant sa première victoire dans un Grand Tour.
Le coureur de l'équipe Movistar est le premier Espagnol à s'imposer dans cette course depuis Alberto Contador en 2014.
Enric Mas s'était pratiquement assuré la victoire en creusant l'écart sur ses rivaux samedi lors de l'avant-dernière étape dans les montagnes de la Sierra Nevada.
Trois fois deuxième de la Vuelta en 2018, 2021 et 2022, il monte enfin sur la plus haute marche du podium, devançant le Slovène Primoz Roglic (Red Bull-Bora-Hansgrohe) et son compatriote Felix Gall (Decathlon CMA-CGM).
Enric Mas avait hérité du maillot rouge de leader à l'issue de la huitième étape après la lourde chute du grand favori de l'épreuve, Tadej Pogacar, qui visait un triplé inédit après ses victoires au Giro et au Tour de France.

items.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump on Sunday said he would consider a request from relatives of those killed in the September 11 attacks to release more records about the event.
items.body:
U.S. President Donald Trump on Sunday said he would consider a request from relatives of those killed in the September 11 attacks to release more records about the event.
"I'm going to look at it when I get back," he told reporters in Ireland before boarding a plane to fly back to the United States.

items.title: Bloco de centro-esquerda tem vantagem apertada em eleições na Suécia, diz boca de urna
items.author: Terje Solsvik, Anna Ringstrom
items.creator: Terje Solsvik, Anna Ringstrom
items.summary: Os partidos de centro-esquerda da Suécia, que apoiam a líder social-democrata Magdalena Andersson para o cargo de primeira-ministra, mantiveram uma vantagem inicial de 51,3% nas eleições parlamentares deste domingo, segundo uma pesquisa de boca de urna realizada pela emissora SVT.
items.body:
Os partidos de centro-esquerda da Suécia, que apoiam a líder social-democrata Magdalena Andersson para o cargo de primeira-ministra, mantiveram uma vantagem inicial de 51,3% nas eleições parlamentares deste domingo, segundo uma pesquisa de boca de urna realizada pela emissora SVT.
Os primeiros resultados da Autoridade Eleitoral da Suécia eram esperados nas próximas horas. Uma pesquisa separada realizada no dia da eleição pela emissora TV4 também mostrou a centro-esquerda na liderança.
Embora muitas vezes sejam indicativas do resultado final, as pesquisas de boca de urna suecas nem sempre se mostraram precisas. Em 2022, por exemplo, uma pesquisa de boca de urna projetava que o bloco de Andersson sairia vitorioso, mas a eleição acabou sendo vencida por uma coalizão de direita liderada por Ulf Kristersson, que hoje é o primeiro-ministro da Suécia.
Uma vitória do bloco de direita levaria os Democratas da Suécia, de extrema-direita — com 17,2% nas pesquisas da SVT —, ao governo pela primeira vez.
A votação é vista por muitos como um referendo sobre o partido -- um grupo com raízes em uma ala neonazista -- que decidirá se o país nórdico de 10,6 milhões de habitantes continuará sua guinada à direita ou voltará ao progressismo pelo qual é conhecido há muito tempo.
A oposição de centro-esquerda mantinha uma vantagem estreita sobre o bloco de direita no poder antes das eleições para o Parlamento, como mostraram várias pesquisas de opinião nesta semana.
Mas Kristersson, que ficou atrás nas pesquisas de opinião ao longo de seus quatro anos no cargo, vem recuperando terreno nas últimas semanas de campanha, enquanto Andersson e seus social-democratas perdem força.
Críticos afirmam que o governo de Kristersson está minando as liberdades civis ao forçar os imigrantes a se adequarem mais às normas culturais suecas ou a deixarem o país, por meio tanto de incentivos quanto de penalidades.
O sucesso eleitoral dos Democratas da Suécia seria bem-vindo pelos partidos de extrema-direita em ascensão na Europa, que estão em alta após a vitória do partido anti-imigrante Alternativa para a Alemanha em uma eleição estadual alemã na semana passada.
A extrema-direita espera obter ganhos nas próximas eleições em toda a Europa, sendo a candidatura do Reunião Nacional à Presidência da França no ano que vem o maior prêmio potencial até o momento.
(Reportagem de Niklas Pollard, Simon Johnson, Johan Ahlander e Tom Little; Reportagem adicional de Ilze Filks, Ardee Napolitano, Janis Laizans para a Reuters TV; Greta Rosen Fondahn, Marie Mannes, Terje Solsvik e Anna Ringstrom)

items.title: No stopping Antonelli and Mercedes now, says Hamilton
items.author: Alan Baldwin
items.creator: Alan Baldwin
items.summary: Kimi Antonelli and Mercedes are sure to win this year's Formula One titles, Ferrari's seven-time champion Lewis Hamilton conceded on Sunday.
items.body:
Kimi Antonelli and Mercedes are sure to win this year's Formula One titles, Ferrari's seven-time champion Lewis Hamilton conceded on Sunday.
"There'll be no stopping him and Mercedes this year," Hamilton said after retirement from the Spanish Grand Prix left him still third overall but now 101 points behind the 20-year-old Italian who has won eight of 14 rounds so far and who replaced him at Mercedes after the 2024 season.
"They've done a phenomenal job and they deserve it."
Mercedes are 145 points clear of second-placed Ferrari, with reigning champions McLaren a further 52 behind.
Antonelli's closest rival is his teammate George Russell, who is now 81 points adrift.
Hamilton retired with a brake problem after starting in fourth place and rising to third on the opening lap.
"I've got no brakes, guys," he told the team by radio before retiring on lap seven in last place. It was his first points blank of the season.
Antonelli has now led 13 consecutive races and last weekend became the first Italian since 1966 to win his home grand prix at Monza.
He is already the youngest driver to lead the championship, and the first Italian since 1953, and would be the youngest champion.
"It’s great, but, you know, we’ve just got to keep pushing, keep delivering the results and, you know, just trying to do the best job I can whenever I go on track," said the youngster.
"Of course, yes, I have a big lead, but you never know what can happen. So I just need to be ready for anything and keep maximising every opportunity I get, and then we’ll see where we end up at the end of the year."
Four-time champion Max Verstappen, second on Sunday for Red Bull, and McLaren's reigning champion Lando Norris both shared Hamilton's view on who would be champion.
"I’m definitely not having a comeback," said Verstappen, who almost snatched the title last year from way back, of his situation 147 points behind the Italian.
Norris, 106 points behind Antonelli in fourth overall, agreed: "He’s leading by 80 points because he’s doing an incredible job," said the Briton.
"I think it’s cool to see someone so young doing such an incredible job and more than likely go on and win the championship."

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo pede suspensões vitalícias após gritos de “Jota” dirigidos a Ruben Neves
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo disse neste domingo que os torcedores que pareciam entoar cantos fazendo referência ao ex-companheiro de seleção de Portugal Diogo Jota, dirigidos a Ruben Neves, durante uma partida da Liga Profissional da Arábia Saudita, deveriam ser banidos dos estádios de futebol para sempre.
items.body:
Cristiano Ronaldo disse neste domingo que os torcedores que pareciam entoar cantos fazendo referência ao ex-companheiro de seleção de Portugal Diogo Jota, dirigidos a Ruben Neves, durante uma partida da Liga Profissional da Arábia Saudita, deveriam ser banidos dos estádios de futebol para sempre.
Os gritos ocorreram no sábado, durante uma partida entre o Al-Taawoun e o Al-Hilal, time de Neves, em Buraidah, na Arábia Saudita.
Jota morreu em 3 de julho de 2025, em um acidente de carro em Zamora, no noroeste da Espanha, juntamente com seu irmão, André Silva. Amigo íntimo de Jota, Neves foi um dos carregadores do caixão no funeral.
Imagens filmadas das arquibancadas durante a partida e divulgadas nas redes sociais pareciam mostrar torcedores gritando “Jota”.
Os gritos chamaram a atenção de Neves, que apontou para o olho e, em seguida, para o céu em resposta.
Ao passar pela zona mista após a partida, Neves comentou: “Espero que eles não saiam para rezar depois disso”.
Em resposta a uma publicação no Instagram que mostrava as imagens, Cristiano Ronaldo comentou em sua conta pessoal.
“A liga precisa tomar medidas e punir esse tipo de comportamento dos torcedores”, disse.
“Isso não é mais futebol, e tem de haver limites. Pessoas que se comportam assim nunca mais deveriam ter permissão para entrar em um estádio.”
A partida terminou 6 x 0 para o Al-Hilal, com Neves jogando 75 minutos antes de ser substituído.
A Reuters entrou em contato com o Al-Taawoun e o Al-Hilal para obter comentários.
(Reportagem de Ruairidh Barlow)

items.title: VAR in focus as Haaland goal gives Man City controversial derby win
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Erling Haaland's controversial goal proved to be the winner for Manchester City against Manchester United in their Premier League clash at Old Trafford on Sunday, but it is unlikely the big Norwegian will have the last word as debate rages whether the derby goal should have been allowed to stand.
items.body:
Erling Haaland's controversial goal proved to be the winner for Manchester City against Manchester United in their Premier League clash at Old Trafford on Sunday, but it is unlikely the big Norwegian will have the last word as debate rages whether the derby goal should have been allowed to stand.
Video reviews showed Haaland was onside when the ball was played, but an attempt by City midfielder Enzo Fernandez to head it into the net was seemingly ignored in the VAR deliberations, with the Argentinian appearing to be in an offside position when Josko Gvardiol played the initial ball in.
The Premier League Match Centre said on social media platform X that Fernandez didn't play the ball, and therefore the goal was allowed to stand, but needless to say the red side of Manchester did not agree with that assessment.
"I just don't get it, I really don't get it, I can't understand how we're trying to help referees, putting so many layers behind them, so many people, bodies and screens, and they can't make the right decision," United coach Michael Carrick fumed.
"It's worrying if that's how the game's seen by those who are officiating it ... I can't be too critical of the players, and I won't be because I think we've done a lot of good things. Today we didn't quite find what we needed.
The United boss, who has taken four points from his first four league games of the season, couldn't hide his disappointment.
"I'm feeling for the fans today. We haven't got as many points as we would've liked at this stage, there's no getting away from that. We've just got to move on and get winning again."
Defender Lisandro Martinez was equally frustrated.
"I think it was offside. What I can't understand is the rules. He was there. I went to him because he was there in front of me, that's why Haaland was free at the back," he explained.
"I want to be calm now, I want to control myself, it's so hard, because you lose, you lose a derby, you lose three points at home ... it's unacceptable. Because it's the best league in the world, you have the best teams in the world, the best players in the world, and now we have to go home with this injustice."

"I'm feeling for the fans today. We haven't got as many points as we would've liked at this stage, there's no getting away from that. We've just got to move on and get winning again."
Defender Lisandro Martinez was equally frustrated. 
"I think it was offside. What I can't understand is the rules. He was there. I went to him because he was there in front of me, that's why Haaland was free at the back," he explained. 
"I want to be calm now, I want to control myself, it's so hard, because you lose, you lose a derby, you lose three points at home ... it's unacceptable. Because it's the best league in the world, you have the best teams in the world, the best players in the world, and now we have to go home with this injustice."

Source: Reuters

items.title: Dos Santos delivers again as Sedjati springs 800m surprise in Budapest
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: World-record holder Alison dos Santos won the men's 400m hurdles, while Djamel Sedjati was the surprise winner of the men's 800 on the final night of the inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship on Sunday.
items.body:
World-record holder Alison dos Santos won the men's 400m hurdles, while Djamel Sedjati was the surprise winner of the men's 800 on the final night of the inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship on Sunday.
Fresh off his world-record run two weeks ago, Brazil's dos Santos clocked 45.98 seconds to beat rivals Rai Benjamin of the U.S. (46.40) and former record-holder Karsten Warholm of Norway (46.78). Jasmine Jones of the U.S. won the women's event in 52.45.
Sedjati of Algeria surged past Canada's 2023 world champion Marco Arop over the final few steps to win the men's 800m in 1:41.91. Arop crossed in 1:42.28, while Kenya's Olympic champion Emmanuel Wanyonyi was third (1:42.44).
Rumesh Pathirage of Sri Lanka threw 91.09m to win the men's javelin by almost five metres.
Likina Amebaw of Ethiopia pulled away to win a tactical women's 5,000m in 14:30.36.
The inaugural Ultimate Championship featured a prize pot of $10 million, the richest ever in the sport. Over 60,000 fans attended over the three sold-out days in Budapest.

items.title: Norris goes from Madring pole high to feeling 'insanely unlucky'
items.author: Alan Baldwin
items.creator: Alan Baldwin
items.summary: Lando Norris went from the high of celebrating one of the best pole positions of his Formula One career to feeling "insanely unlucky" as the champion rued a win that got away through no fault of his own on Sunday.
items.body:
Lando Norris went from the high of celebrating one of the [USN:L6N45404Y TEXT:"best pole positions"] of his Formula One career to feeling "insanely unlucky" as the champion rued a win that got away through no fault of his own on Sunday.
The McLaren driver looked set for his third victory of the season after starting at the front of the grid for the [USN:L6N45505G TEXT:"Spanish Grand Prix"] debut of Madrid's new track and carving out a lead of more than six seconds before a virtual safety car scuppered his chances.
With overtaking as good as impossible, he had to settle for third behind Mercedes' winner Kimi Antonelli and Red Bull's Max Verstappen.
"There was nothing I could do," Norris said of a situation where rivals behind him were able to pit and gain a precious time advantage but he was unable to do so because he had already gone past the pit lane entrance seconds earlier.
When he pitted a lap later, the lead was gone for good.
"Congrats to Kimi and Max. They drove a good race today, so just luck not on our side," said Norris.
Third place left the Briton still fourth overall and 106 points behind leader Antonelli, whose win was his eighth of the campaign.
Asked if he felt it was 'the one that got away', Norris qualified that.
"It depends how you define 'got away'. It’s not like we did anything that made us lose it. We were just insanely unlucky today," he said. "I was the only one on the whole grid that didn’t get the chance to do the pit stop. That’s just unfortunate.
"There’s been plenty of times where I’ve gained from it in the past and times where I’ve lost from it, and it’s racing, but never when fighting for a win.
"It’s not the team’s fault, it’s not my fault. Simple as that. We were just unlucky," he added when asked if he or the team might have anticipated race control calling the virtual safety car once Aston Martin's Lance Stroll had stopped on track.
Norris said staying out longer had not been an option either, with rivals on fresher tyres.
"I had to come in at the end of the lap because it was the only chance. It was still effectively some pit loss, the fact that everyone’s kind of on colder tyres and you’re still minimising the pit loss," he said.
"The medium tyre was destroyed and the hard tyre was amazing."

items.title: Golf Lowry delights home fans and cheering Trump with Irish Open win
items.author: Bo Erickson, Padraic Halpin
items.creator: Bo Erickson, Padraic Halpin
items.summary: Shane Lowry won the Irish Open for the second time on Sunday to the delight of the home crowd and a cheering U.S. President Donald Trump, who presented the Irishman with the trophy at the west of Ireland course owned by the Trump family.
items.body:
Shane Lowry won the Irish Open for the second time on Sunday to the delight of the home crowd and a cheering U.S. President Donald Trump, who presented the Irishman with the trophy at the west of Ireland course owned by the Trump family.
Trump was among the spectators during a [USN:L6N454021 TEXT:"48-hour visit"] to Ireland. He arrived on Saturday after meeting Irish leaders in Dublin, forcing play to pause while his presidential helicopter landed between a fairway and a nearby field of cows.
Lowry, who described Saturday's interruption as "an insane day", had taken control with an eight-under course record the day before and came one shot from matching it on Sunday, draining an 18th hold birdie to finish with a 23-under-par total.
"He was unbelievable. He's a great guy," Trump said of Lowry, before further delighting the home fans by saying he was going to take tariffs off Irish whiskey.
Lowry, who fought back tears as he paid tribute to his family at the end of his round, thanked Trump and Irish Prime Minister Micheal Martin for being at the event, saying it was amazing to have a U.S. president in attendance.
The 2019 British Open champion's record 11-shot victory came 17 years after he became just the third amateur player to win a European Tour event at his home tournament.
TRUMP WATCHES ON Trump, wearing a suit and white USA cap, greeted Lowry on the first tee and watched from a few feet away as he teed off. Trump told reporters that Lowry was "playing great." Lowry later said it was "a bit mad" to have the U.S. President watching on.
While thousands of anti-Trump protesters marched through Dublin on Saturday, the president was cheered heartily throughout Sunday and during a brief appearance in the club bar in the adjoining hotel where he stayed on Saturday night.
Trump watched the action on both days from an 18th-green balcony alongside his sons, Don Jr. and Eric and some of his grandchildren. He was joined by U.S. major champions Brooks Koepka and Patrick Reed, who finished in second place.
Trump has always received a warm welcome in the tiny County Clare village of Doonbeg where the golf resort he bought in 2014 is a major employer for the local population of 300. Some fans wore the president's bright red "Make America Great Again" hats.
"He will have detractors and people are not very happy politically-wise, but I just feel it's a golf event," said 69-year-old retiree Kathryn Murphy, welcoming Trump's attendance and support for the local economy.
"I'm sure he has 1 million and one things to do, and it's a fantastic honour to have him here because America is a very good country to Ireland."

items.summary: Ukraine's Zelenskiy imposes sanctions on former press secretary    Reuters
items.raw_description: Ukraine's Zelenskiy imposes sanctions on former press secretary    Reuters

items.title: Ukraine's Zelenskiy imposes sanctions on former press secretary
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskiy imposed sanctions on a former press secretary on Sunday, accusing her and nine others of spreading Russian propaganda and of supporting Russia's aggressive policy toward Ukraine.
items.body:
Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskiy imposed sanctions on a former press secretary on Sunday, accusing her and nine others of spreading Russian propaganda and of supporting Russia's aggressive policy toward Ukraine.
Yuliia Mendel — who worked with Zelenskiy from 2019 to 2021, before Russia's invasion — responded with a message on Facebook saying it was unconstitutional to impose sanctions on Ukrainian citizens. She did not comment on the specific accusations.
Mendel has given interviews criticising Zelenskiy's record since last year, when a number of members of the president's inner circle became embroiled in [USN:L1N41R08N TEXT:"corruption scandals"]. The suspects have denied the charges that have not been tested in court.
The sanctions — announced by Zelenskiy in a decree — would last for 10 years and included asset freezes and restrictions on trade, the document read.
They were an unusual measure to use against a former member of staff, though they have been used against political figures.
In 2025, Ukraine imposed sanctions on former president and opposition politician Petro Poroshenko, including an asset freeze and a ban on withdrawing capital from the country, for what the domestic spy agency said were "national security" reasons.
Sunday's order "imposes restrictions on 10 Russian and Ukrainian individuals who spread disinformation and Russian propaganda and support Russia’s aggressive policy toward Ukraine. Yuliia Mendel is among those sanctioned," the presidency said in a statement.
Mendel, Zelenskiy's first press secretary after he became president, wrote on Facebook that she had been expecting the move.
"Sanctions against Ukrainian citizens are unconstitutional, as are many of Zelenskiy's other decisions," she added. "Volodymyr Zelenskiy is imposing them on anyone who advocates for peace in Ukraine."

items.title: Trump reitera apoio à Irlanda unificada e diz que não falará sobre Escócia “por enquanto”
items.author: Bo Erickson, Padraic Halpin
items.creator: Bo Erickson, Padraic Halpin
items.summary: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, reiterou neste domingo seu apoio à separação da Irlanda do Norte do Reino Unido para se unificar com a República da Irlanda, mas afirmou que “ainda” não falaria sobre a independência da Escócia.
items.body:
O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, reiterou neste domingo seu apoio à separação da Irlanda do Norte do Reino Unido para se unificar com a República da Irlanda, mas afirmou que “ainda” não falaria sobre a independência da Escócia.
Trump surpreendeu autoridades em Dublin e irritou políticos pró-britânicos na Irlanda do Norte e em Londres ao apoiar entusiasticamente a unificação irlandesa durante uma visita a Dublin no sábado, dizendo que “adoraria” ver isso acontecer o mais rápido possível.
“Vocês têm a Irlanda do Norte e têm a Irlanda, e me parece que uma das coisas mais ‘naturais’ de todos os tempos é uni-las”, disse Trump aos repórteres durante uma visita a um torneio de golfe em um de seus resorts, reforçando seus comentários iniciais.
“Vocês perguntaram sobre a Escócia. Sobre isso, ainda não vou falar. Vou deixar para outro dia”, acrescentou.
A Escócia, onde a família Trump também possui um resort de golfe, votou contra a independência do resto do Reino Unido em 2014. O primeiro-ministro do Reino Unido, Andy Burnham, descartou a realização de outra votação, bem como um referendo sobre a saída da Irlanda do Norte do Reino Unido.
Trump fez seus comentários sobre a unidade irlandesa após uma reunião com Micheal Martin, o primeiro-ministro da Irlanda. Em suas primeiras declarações desde as falas de Trump, o premiê irlandês disse que a reação de alguns políticos unionistas foi “exagerada”.
“Não deveria ser uma surpresa. Ele tem uma perspectiva diferente sobre as coisas”, disse Martin aos repórteres no domingo, após se encontrar novamente com Trump para almoçar no campo de golfe.
Martin disse que os dois discutiram a Irlanda do Norte e sua relação com a República da Irlanda e que também explicou ao presidente como a região administrada pelos britânicos alcançou a paz.
Um acordo de paz de 1998 pôs fim a três décadas de violência entre nacionalistas irlandeses que buscavam uma Irlanda unificada e unionistas que queriam que a Irlanda do Norte continuasse fazendo parte do Reino Unido.
“Apoio a unificação, mas não vejo isso acontecendo agora. Fui muito claro quanto a isso”, disse Martin à BBC News em uma entrevista separada.
“É provável que, se uma votação fosse realizada na próxima semana, seria muito difícil que fosse aprovada.”
(Reportagem de Bo Erickson, em Doonbeg; Padraic Halpin e Conor Humphries, em Dublin, e Alistair Smout, em Londres)

items.title: Rússia ataca trem na fronteira entre Ucrânia e Polônia logo após passagem de "trem diplomático"
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Um drone russo atingiu um trem de passageiros na fronteira da Ucrânia com a Polônia, membro da aliança militar ocidental Organização do Tratado do Atlântico Norte (Otan), neste domingo, logo após o ex-primeiro-ministro do Reino Unido Boris Johnson e outros diplomatas europeus terem utilizado a mesma linha.
items.body:
Um drone russo atingiu um trem de passageiros na fronteira da Ucrânia com a Polônia, membro da aliança militar ocidental Organização do Tratado do Atlântico Norte (Otan), neste domingo, logo após o ex-primeiro-ministro do Reino Unido Boris Johnson e outros diplomatas europeus terem utilizado a mesma linha.
O trem, que circulava por uma rota frequentemente utilizada por delegações estrangeiras que retornam de Kiev, foi atacado a apenas 2 quilômetros da fronteira com a Polônia, informou a operadora ferroviária ucraniana.
Não houve relatos de vítimas.
“Não era o nosso trem, mas aquele que passava poucos minutos depois de nós, perto da passagem de fronteira. Ele foi esvaziado quando o drone se aproximou e ninguém ficou ferido”, disse Carl Bildt, ex-primeiro-ministro da Suécia, no X.
Ele e outros políticos estavam voltando para a Europa de trem após participarem de uma conferência em Kiev.
“É perfeitamente possível que o alvo pretendido pelo drone russo fosse o trem diplomático, que partiu da estação antes do previsto após os horários dos trens terem sido ajustados em tempo real devido à constante ameaça de ataques russos”, informou a operadora ferroviária ucraniana, Ukrzaliznytsia, no Telegram.
Boris Johnson, que também estava no trem que partiu da estação pouco antes do ataque, condenou o ataque como “aleatório e sem sentido” em uma publicação no Instagram.
Com a linha de frente da guerra praticamente imóvel, tanto Moscou quanto Kiev intensificaram os ataques de longo alcance nas últimas semanas para tentar mudar o rumo da guerra.
O ministro das Relações Exteriores da Polônia, Radoslaw Sikorski, descreveu os crescentes ataques da Rússia às portas da Otan como “uma escalada”.
No início do domingo, um caminhão a menos de 1 km da fronteira da Ucrânia com a Polônia também foi atingido, levando o posto de fronteira de Dorohusk-Yahodyn a interromper brevemente suas operações, segundo guardas de fronteira.
O Ministério da Defesa da Rússia afirmou ter atacado infraestruturas que facilitam o transporte de cargas militares da Europa no oeste da Ucrânia.
A Rússia começou a atacar os postos de fronteira da Ucrânia com seus aliados ocidentais nas últimas semanas, como parte de uma campanha crescente de ambos os lados para minar a infraestrutura econômica do adversário, mais de quatro anos após o início da invasão russa.
(Reportagem de Felix Light, Pavel Polityuk, Andriy Perun e Anna Wlodarczak-Semczuk)

items.title: Ahead of Fed meeting, Trump says US should have world's lowest interest rate
items.author: Bo Erickson, Padraic Halpin, Conor Humphries
items.creator: Bo Erickson, Padraic Halpin, Conor Humphries
items.summary: No country should have lower interest rates than the U.S., President Donald Trump said on Sunday, days before the Federal Reserve's next policy meeting.
items.body:
No country should have lower interest rates than the U.S., President Donald Trump said on Sunday, days before the Federal Reserve's next policy meeting.
Speaking to reporters at the Irish Open golf tournament, Trump said he did not know whether Fed policy makers will raise interest rates at their meeting this week. But he argued that the U.S. "should be paying the lowest interest rate in the world" no matter what the Federal Reserve's data indicates about inflation and the economy.
The Fed meeting will take place less than a week after a key measure of [USN:L1N452123 TEXT:"underlying inflation"], the Labor Department's Consumer Price Index, on Friday posted its largest increase in four months. That reinforced expectations that the U.S. central bank will raise rates.
The central bank's governors are meeting just weeks before the midterm elections that will determine whether Republicans keep their slim majorities in both chambers of the U.S. Congress. A rate hike could add to voter concerns about affordability, according to recent [USN:L6N44M0S0 TEXT:"Reuters/Ipsos"] polls.
Trump's approval ratings have fallen as inflation has persisted. He has argued that the Fed's interest rate levels have helped other countries at the expense of the U.S.
“I know more about formulas than anybody, and with the best credit in the world, we make other countries rich," Trump said on Sunday.
The president, a frequent critic of former Fed chair Jay Powell, has been more supportive of Fed leadership since his own pick for chair, Kevin Warsh, took charge earlier this year. But Trump recently has made his demands more clear.
"LOWER THE RATE OR I'LL STOP TRADING WITH COUNTRIES WITH WHICH WE HAVE A DEFICIT," Trump posted on social media two weeks ago.
Trump "will defend the independence of Kevin Warsh above all" no matter what the Fed does with interest rates, National Economic Council Director Kevin Hassett told "Fox News Sunday."
But Hassett also underscored Trump's own preferences, saying "if it's a rate hike … I'm sure he's not going to be super happy about it."

items.title: Turquía detiene a decenas de personas tras serie de redadas dirigidas contra grupos LGBTQ+
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Las autoridades turcas detuvieron al menos a 47 personas tras una serie de redadas en las oficinas de asociaciones LGBTQ+ en el marco de una investigación sobre prostitución y obscenidad, informó la fiscalía.
items.body:
Las autoridades turcas detuvieron al menos a 47 personas tras una serie de redadas en las oficinas de asociaciones LGBTQ+ en el marco de una investigación sobre prostitución y obscenidad, informó la fiscalía.
Esta campaña de represión forma parte de una iniciativa que, según el Gobierno, tiene como objetivo proteger los valores familiares.
La Fiscalía General de Estambul informó que durante el fin de semana se llevaron a cabo operaciones en 12 provincias contra 38 sospechosos, de los cuales 26 fueron detenidos, y las autoridades incautaron drogas, equipos digitales, alcohol de contrabando y un arma de fuego.
En un comunicado aparte, la Fiscalía General de Ankara indicó que otras 21 personas habían sido detenidas en el marco de una investigación sobre la asociación LGBTQ+ Kaos GL y que aún se buscaba a cinco personas.
Kaos GL dijo que al menos 50 activistas habían sido detenidos, entre ellos más de 10 que fueron detenidos en redadas policiales en sus domicilios.
Además, señaló que las autoridades bloquearon el acceso a decenas de sitios web y cuentas en redes sociales vinculadas a organizaciones LGBTQ+ y activistas.
Bajo el lema "Mi familia está a salvo", la campaña de represión del Gobierno se produce mientras el presidente Tayyip Erdogan promueve la "Década de la Familia y la Población", una iniciativa destinada a hacer frente a la caída de la natalidad y al envejecimiento de la población.
Las organizaciones de derechos humanos han acusado al Gobierno turco de atacar cada vez más a la comunidad LGBTQ+ en los últimos años mediante un endurecimiento de la retórica y las restricciones.
"El verdadero nombre de esta operación no es 'Mi familia está a salvo'; se trata de discriminación impulsada por el Estado, política del miedo y desmantelamiento de la sociedad civil", dijo la Asociación Turca de Derechos Humanos en X.
Nacho Sánchez Amor, ponente del Parlamento Europeo para Turquía, calificó la amplia oleada de detenciones como "una escalada impactante" de la represión.
"Esta imposición de una agenda moral constituye una violación flagrante de los derechos fundamentales y de los compromisos internacionales de Turquía, lo que lleva al país por un camino oscuro", dijo Amor en una publicación en X.
La fiscalía dijo que existían pruebas de que se estaba ejerciendo una influencia inadecuada sobre niños y menores en cuestiones relacionadas con la orientación sexual y la identidad de género.
El ministro de Justicia, Akin Gurlek, dijo que las investigaciones coordinadas por las fiscalías de Estambul, Ankara, Esmirna, Aydin y Mersin incluían procedimientos judiciales contra 162 sospechosos, nueve asociaciones y 13 empresas en 15 provincias.

items.title: Orioles put RHP Kyle Bradish on IL, likely ending his season
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Baltimore right-hander Kyle Bradish could miss the rest of the season after the Orioles placed him on the 15-day injured list Sunday with lower abdominal discomfort.
items.body:
Baltimore right-hander Kyle Bradish could miss the rest of the season after the Orioles placed him on the 15-day injured list Sunday with lower abdominal discomfort.
The Orioles recalled right-hander Yaramil Hiraldo from Triple-A Norfolk to fill Bradish's roster spot.
Bradish, 30, who signed a five-year, $90 million contract extension in July, is 7-14 with a 4.12 ERA in 29 starts this season. Of late, he has given up five earned runs or more in three of his last nine starts and has failed to pitch five innings five times in that span.
Drafted by the Los Angeles Angels in the fourth round in 2018 and acquired by the Orioles in 2019, Bradish debuted in 2022 and is 26-29 in 96 starts with a 3.67 ERA over 512 2/3 innings. He underwent Tommy John surgery in June 2024 and made just six starts last season.
Hiraldo, 30, is 1-0 with a 5.87 ERA in seven relief appearances this season after posting a 4.58 ERA in 18 relief outings last season, his first in the majors.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Trump diz que “forças muito negativas” estão gerando preocupações exageradas sobre a IA
items.author: Bo Erickson, Padraic Halpin
items.creator: Bo Erickson, Padraic Halpin
items.summary: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, comparou neste domingo os críticos da inteligência artificial a “forças muito negativas” que levantam cenários que não vão acontecer, e afirmou que quer garantir que os EUA continuem sendo líderes do setor.
items.body:
O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, comparou neste domingo os críticos da inteligência artificial a “forças muito negativas” que levantam cenários que não vão acontecer, e afirmou que quer garantir que os EUA continuem sendo líderes do setor.
“Estamos à frente da China em IA. Somos o país mais sofisticado do mundo e, francamente, quero que continue assim, porque quem vencer na IA vence”, disse Trump a repórteres em seu campo de golfe na Irlanda, quando questionado se o setor de IA deveria desacelerar ou ser mais regulamentado.
“Poderíamos estabelecer limites. Podemos fazer isso e aquilo. Mas acho que há muitas forças muito negativas levantando essa questão, que não deveriam estar fazendo isso, e estão trazendo à tona coisas que não vão acontecer.”
Trump tem resistido a alimentar preocupações sobre a IA.
O debate público sobre a IA se intensificou nos EUA depois que dois pesquisadores da Anthropic alertaram que o rápido avanço da tecnologia poderia levar à extinção da raça humana em um futuro não muito distante.
Em seu segundo mandato, Trump tem apoiado amplamente as empresas de IA. Esses líderes do setor de IA e outras empresas de tecnologia também têm apoiado as iniciativas de Trump.
Executivos do setor de IA injetaram dinheiro na campanha para as eleições legislativas de meio de mandato, que acontecerão em 3 de novembro e determinarão o controle do Congresso dos EUA.
O grupo de financiamento eleitoral do presidente-executivo da SpaceX, Elon Musk, o America PAC, já gastou milhões apoiando candidatos republicanos e deve desempenhar um papel importante nos esforços para aumentar a participação eleitoral.
O Pentágono alertou este ano sobre os riscos do modelo da Anthropic.
Após os alertas dos pesquisadores, alguns presidentes-executivos do setor de IA estão pressionando para que o avanço dos modelos seja desacelerado.
No sábado, o presidente-executivo da Anthropic, Dario Amodei, apresentou uma estrutura em três etapas destinada a moderar o ritmo do desenvolvimento e criar mais tempo para gerenciar os riscos. A proposta recebeu imediatamente o apoio de vários outros executivos de grandes empresas de IA, incluindo Musk e o presidente-executivo da OpenAI, Sam Altman.
Em uma entrevista exibida no domingo no programa da CBS “Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan”, Amodei disse que a competição entre empresas de IA dos EUA e da China é o “dilema mais difícil” na tentativa de estabelecer um “limite de velocidade” para o ritmo de desenvolvimento da IA.
“Não devemos nos iludir, porque os incentivos para sair na frente e a vantagem militar que se obtém com isso são tão grandes que a capacidade de verificar se o outro lado não está trapaceando precisa ser irrefutável”, disse ele. “Portanto, acho que isso vai levar anos, e, honestamente, não sei se é possível.”
Jacob Coxon, um dos pesquisadores da Anthropic que se demitiu e depois emitiu os alertas, defendeu que os EUA trabalhem em conjunto com outros países para garantir um ritmo equilibrado.
“Acho que precisamos de coordenação internacional; caso contrário, corremos o risco de entrar na mesma corrida que a China, o que poderia ser igualmente perigoso”, disse Coxon no programa Meet the Press, da NBC.
(Reportagem de Bo Erickson; Reportagem adicional de Joseph Ax)

items.title: Kane winner hands Bayern laborious 2-1 win at promoted  Elversberg
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Visitors Bayern Munich needed a second-half winner from Harry Kane to battle past promoted Elversberg 2-1 on Sunday, and snap the hosts two-game winning start to the season.
items.body:
Visitors Bayern Munich needed a second-half winner from Harry Kane to battle past promoted Elversberg 2-1 on Sunday, and snap the hosts two-game winning start to the season.
Kane threaded a shot past two defenders and the Elversberg keeper in the 72nd minute to hand the champions a nervous victory against the Bundesliga newcomers.
Elversberg, buoyed by wins over Bayer Leverkusen and Borussia Moenchengladbach in their previous two league outings, showed no signs of being overawed by their illustrious opponents in their first ever Bundesliga encounter and had the visitors on the backfoot at the start.
They also had the better scoring chances until Ismael Saibari found just enough space down the left to cut back into the box for Lennart Karl to finish the move with a tap-in at the far post in the 26th minute.
But Vincent Kompany's team eased off almost instantly and the hosts bounced back, striking just past the hour mark when Maurice Krattenmacher curled a stunning effort into the top far corner to level.
The Bavarians heeded the wake-up call, hit the woodwork with Michael Olise in the 70th before England captain Kane bagged the winner two minutes later.
Bayern climbed up to fourth in the Bundesliga on seven points, two off leaders Freiburg and Borussia Dortmund, who have three wins from three matches. Elversberg are a point behind in sixth place.

items.title: India cruise past Afghanistan as Sharma blitz earns series lead
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: India claimed a dominant seven-wicket victory over Afghanistan in the first Twenty20 international in New Delhi on Sunday, taking a 1-0 lead in the three-match series after chasing down a victory target of 157 with 38 balls to spare.
items.body:
India claimed a dominant seven-wicket victory over Afghanistan in the first Twenty20 international in New Delhi on Sunday, taking a 1-0 lead in the three-match series after chasing down a victory target of 157 with 38 balls to spare.
After Sanju Samson fell in the third over, Abhishek Sharma launched a blistering counterattack, smashing 82 off 32 balls, while Ishan Kishan contributed 42 as the pair put India firmly in control of the chase.
Sharma's aggressive strokeplay ensured Afghanistan never threatened the target, with India cruising towards victory before Mohammad Nabi struck twice late in the innings to remove both Sharma and Kishan.
Captain Shreyas Iyer and Tilak Varma then guided their side over the line, with Iyer finishing unbeaten on eight from five deliveries.
Afghanistan had earlier made a poor start after being put in to bat, with Jasprit Bumrah, returning to the side after a knee injury, striking in the opening over to dismiss Rahmanullah Gurbaz for a duck.
They slipped to 41-4 inside the powerplay, with captain Ibrahim Zadran (11) and Sediqullah Atal (13) among the early casualties.
A steady stream of wickets kept Afghanistan under pressure throughout the innings, but Azmatullah Omarzai provided some resistance with a counter-attacking 64 off 44 balls.
The all-rounder shared a crucial 83-run partnership with Mohammad Nabi (33) to revive the innings before Nabi fell to Arshdeep Singh, who applied the brakes in the death overs and finished with figures of 3-19.
India will face Afghanistan next on Tuesday.

items.title: Mas gana La Vuelta a España y logra su primera victoria en una Gran Vuelta
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Enric Mas, del equipo Movistar, ganó el domingo La Vuelta a España y se alzó con su primera victoria en una Gran Vuelta, convirtiéndose en el primer ciclista español en ganar la carrera desde Alberto Contador en 2014, mientras que Tobias Johannessen, del equipo Uno-X Mobility, se impuso en la última etapa.
items.body:
Enric Mas, del equipo Movistar, ganó el domingo La Vuelta a España y se alzó con su primera victoria en una Gran Vuelta, convirtiéndose en el primer ciclista español en ganar la carrera desde Alberto Contador en 2014, mientras que Tobias Johannessen, del equipo Uno-X Mobility, se impuso en la última etapa.
Mas prácticamente se aseguró la victoria al superar la brutal penúltima etapa del sábado en la Sierra Nevada, donde consiguió una ventaja de más de dos minutos de cara a la etapa final del domingo en Granada.
Tras haber quedado tres veces subcampeón de la Vuelta en 2018, 2021 y 2022, Mas subió por fin al escalón más alto con el maillot rojo, consiguiendo su primer título de Gran Vuelta en su propio país.
Terminó con una ventaja de 2 minutos y 15 segundos sobre Primož Roglič, de Red Bull-Bora-Hansgrohe, mientras que Félix Gall, del Decathlon CMA CGM Team, quedó tercero.
Mas había heredado el maillot rojo después de que el intento del gran favorito de la carrera, Tadej Pogačar, de completar el triplete en las Grandes Vueltas del ciclismo, llegó a un doloroso final al sufrir una caída en la octava etapa.
Johannessen ganó la etapa final —en la que se neutralizaron los tiempos de la clasificación general para la cuarta y última vuelta—, superando en la línea de meta a Alessandro Romele, de XDS Astana, y a Ramses Debruyne, de Alpecin-Premier Tech.
Mas terminó luego con el pelotón y cruzó la línea de meta flanqueado por sus compañeros del Movistar, mientras el público lo animaba a gritos.

items.summary: Erling Haaland marcou no segundo tempo e garantiu a vitória por 1 x 0 do Manchester City, que jogava com 10 jogadores, sobre seu arquirrival Manchester United, no Old Trafford, neste domingo.
items.body:
Erling Haaland marcou no segundo tempo e garantiu a vitória por 1 x 0 do Manchester City, que jogava com 10 jogadores, sobre seu arquirrival Manchester United, no Old Trafford, neste domingo.
O gol foi inicialmente anulado por impedimento, mas a decisão foi revertida após uma revisão do VAR.
Phil Foden, do City, foi expulso no meio do primeiro tempo por dar um chute em Bruno Fernandes, e o United acertou a trave duas vezes, por meio de Marcus Rashford e Kobbie Mainoo, antes e depois do intervalo, enquanto tentava aproveitar a vantagem numérica.
No entanto, a maré virou aos 15 minutos do segundo tempo, quando Haaland mandou a bola para o fundo da rede de um ângulo fechado e, embora o gol tenha sido inicialmente anulado por impedimento, uma revisão do VAR levou à reversão da decisão, com imagens de vídeo mostrando que o pé estendido do zagueiro Patrick Dorgu manteve o norueguês em posição válida.
Com a vitória, o City sobe para a segunda colocação do Campeonato Inglês, com 12 pontos em quatro partidas, atrás do campeão Arsenal apenas no saldo de gols, enquanto o United ocupa a 13ª posição, com quatro pontos em quatro partidas.
(Reportagem de Andy Cawthorne, em Manchester)

items.title: Mas ends long wait for Grand Tour glory with home Vuelta win
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Movistar's Enric Mas ended years of heartbreak by winning the Vuelta a Espana on Sunday, claiming his maiden Grand Tour victory while also becoming the first Spanish champion since Alberto Contador in 2014.
items.body:
Movistar's Enric Mas ended years of heartbreak by winning the Vuelta a Espana on Sunday, claiming his maiden Grand Tour victory while also becoming the first Spanish champion since Alberto Contador in 2014.
Mas all but secured the win when he survived [USN:L1N45404E TEXT:"Saturday's brutal penultimate stage"] in the Sierra Nevada mountains, where he established a lead of over two minutes ahead of the ceremonial final stage in Granada won by Tobias Johannessen of Uno-X Mobility.
A three-time runner-up in the Vuelta in 2018, 2021 and 2022, the 31-year-old Mas finally stood on the top step with the red jersey, claiming the biggest victory of his career after racing through over 3,000 kilometres on home roads.
"It's just special. It's been a day to remember, a special Vuelta, and it has been wonderful," Mas said.
"There's always tension about what could happen, but you've seen it all went smoothly, so we're delighted and we enjoyed every kilometre today.
"It was a long wait and a long way to today. But to be honest, it was always special Vueltas. This one, I think, is the special one."
He finished two minutes and 15 seconds ahead of Red Bull-Bora-Hansgrohe rider Primoz Roglic while Felix Gall of Decathlon CMA CGM Team came in third.
Mas had inherited the red jersey after overwhelming race favourite Tadej Pogacar's bid to complete cycling's Grand Tour hat-trick came to a painful end when he [USN:L6N44Q04G TEXT:"crashed out on stage eight"], bringing his season to a premature end.
GENUINE CONTENDER However, Mas was up to the task, defending the red jersey and turning an unexpected opportunity into the biggest victory of his career.
He dropped four-times Vuelta champion Roglic in the final kilometres of stage 20 to effectively win the general classification battle, denying the Slovenian what would have been a record fifth title.
Johannessen won the final stage -- where the general classification times for the fourth and final circuit were neutralised -- beating Alessandro Romele (XDS Astana) and Ramses Debruyne (Alpecin-Premier Tech) to the finish line.
"I've been knocking on that door for a long time, well over three years since the last time. It feels really special to do it today. I don't know what to say. I'm so happy," Johannessen said.
Mas then finished with the bunch and crossed the line with his Movistar teammates by his side and the crowd roaring him on before he thanked his family.
"They are the ones responsible for all of this, for the fact that I'm up here on the top step," Mas said.
"Truly, from the bottom of my heart, thank you so much. The fans have been amazing since we started the season, so please keep it up, it helps us a lot."

items.title: Trump diz que EUA podem permanecer no Irã e ficar com petróleo
items.author: Bo Erickson, Conor Humphries
items.creator: Bo Erickson, Conor Humphries
items.summary: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, sugeriu neste domingo que os EUA podem permanecer no Irã e “ficar com o petróleo”, traçando um paralelo com a tentativa do país de assumir o controle de um quinto das vastas reservas de petróleo da Venezuela.
items.body:
O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, sugeriu neste domingo que os EUA podem permanecer no Irã e “ficar com o petróleo”, traçando um paralelo com a tentativa do país de assumir o controle de um quinto das vastas reservas de petróleo da Venezuela.
Durante uma viagem à Irlanda para reuniões e para assistir a partidas de golfe, ele reiterou que ainda espera que a guerra no Irã termine este ano, possivelmente logo após as eleições legislativas de meio de mandato previstas para novembro nos Estados Unidos.
Falando no campeonato de golfe Irish Open, Trump acrescentou que o preço da gasolina “cairia vertiginosamente” assim que a guerra no Irã terminasse.
A turbulência no Oriente Médio tem abalado os mercados de petróleo, com os operadores do setor esperando que os preços voltem a subir na segunda-feira, após um ataque a um oleoduto saudita.
Trump afirmou que só fecharia o “acordo certo” e não aceitará um que seja “ruim”, acrescentando que o Irã está “pedindo constantemente” por negociações de paz — uma afirmação que Teerã já rejeitou no passado.
Mas o presidente também apresentou outra opção: manter o diálogo com o Irã. Ele traçou um paralelo com o acordo dos EUA com a Venezuela, anunciado em agosto.
“No fim das contas, vamos sair (do Irã), a menos que decidamos ficar e ficar com o petróleo, como na Venezuela”, disse Trump, acrescentando que a receita obtida pelos EUA na Venezuela “pagou a guerra muitas vezes”.
(Reportagem de Bo Erickson, em Doonbeg, e Padraic Halpin e Conor Humphries, em Dublin)

items.title: Israel y el Líbano se reunirán en Roma en octubre, dice funcionario del Departamento de Estado EEUU
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Israel y el Líbano se reunirán en Roma en octubre para debatir un acuerdo de seguridad negociado por Estados Unidos con el objetivo de aliviar las hostilidades a lo largo de la frontera, dijo a Reuters un responsable del Departamento de Estado.
items.body:
Israel y el Líbano se reunirán en Roma en octubre para debatir un acuerdo de seguridad negociado por Estados Unidos con el objetivo de aliviar las hostilidades a lo largo de la frontera, dijo a Reuters un responsable del Departamento de Estado.
La aplicación continuada del acuerdo "sigue siendo el único mecanismo viable para restablecer la soberanía del Líbano y la seguridad de Israel", dijo el funcionario, que añadió que los embajadores libanés e israelí se reunirán en Washington la próxima semana.
La séptima ronda de negociaciones en la capital italiana concluyó en agosto sin que se lograra ningún avance en cuestiones territoriales clave.
Hezbolá e Israel volvieron a entrar en guerra el 2 de marzo en medio de un conflicto regional más amplio.
El Ejército israelí ocupa lo que describe como una "zona de contención" de unos 10 km (6 millas) de profundidad en el Líbano a lo largo de toda la frontera israelí. Las autoridades israelíes dicen que la zona es necesaria para proteger a las comunidades del norte de Israel de los ataques lanzados por Hezbolá.
Más de 4.300 personas han perdido la vida a causa de los ataques israelíes en el Líbano desde marzo, según el Ministerio de Salud libanés.

items.title: Lille go top as Lens rally to draw 2-2 at Le Mans
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Last season’s runners-up RC Lens fought back from two goals down to draw 2-2 at promoted Le Mans on Sunday, while Lille went top of the Ligue 1 standings after an easy 2-0 triumph over Troyes.
items.body:
Last season’s runners-up RC Lens fought back from two goals down to draw 2-2 at promoted Le Mans on Sunday, while Lille went top of the Ligue 1 standings after an easy 2-0 triumph over Troyes.
The victory put Lille top with 10 points from four matches, ahead of Monaco and Rennes on goal difference.
Lens, who had lost two of their opening three fixtures of the campaign, moved to four points while Le Mans are still looking for their first win of the season.
Le Mans looked in command in the first half at Stade Marie-Marvingt after Adil Bourabaa headed home a rebound after Louis Mafouta’s effort bounced back off the crossbar in the 32nd minute and then a quick counter-attack allowed Lucas Calodat to double their advantage in the 44th minute.
Lens pulled one back from tall Senegalese striker Abdallah Sima in stoppage time before the break and then equalised with another header, this time from substitute Franjo Ivanovic six minutes into the second half.
Thorgan Hazard hammered a free kick against the crossbar in the 80th minute as Lens came within inches of completing a turnaround.
Lille bounced back after their home loss to Real Betis in the Champions League in midweek to easily beat Troyes in a one-sided encounter at Stade Pierre-Mauroy.
Fullback Tiago Santos scored for a second time this season as he curled a first-time, right-footed shot into the far top corner.
Ethan Mbappe, sent off in the Champions League in midweek, came on as a substitute to add the second goal in stoppage time.
Later on Sunday, champions Paris St Germain will seek their first league win of the season as they visit Stade Brestois.

items.title: Bolt unfazed by robot's record run, eyes Manchester derby instead
items.author: Lori Ewing
items.creator: Lori Ewing
items.summary: Most athletes might bristle at seeing their records being broken. When eight-time Olympic champion Usain Bolt learned that a robot in China had eclipsed his 100-metres world record by almost a second, he was rather amused by the turn of events.
items.body:
Most athletes might bristle at seeing their records being broken. When eight-time Olympic champion Usain Bolt learned that a robot in China had eclipsed his 100-metres world record by almost a second, he was rather amused by the turn of events.
"It's just one of those things. I guess that's where the world is going right now," the Jamaican said with a laugh and a shrug. "It just made me smile."
A couple of weeks ago, "Robot beats Bolt" was splashed across headlines after [USN:L8N44N18V TEXT:"Tiangong Ultra"] won the 100m final at the second World Humanoid Robot Games, clocking 8.64 seconds, almost a second faster than Bolt's 9.58 world-record set in 2009.
The 40-year-old Bolt was in relaxed form as he met reporters in Budapest on the final day of the inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship, delivering a stream of anecdotes and one-liners that showed why he remains one of athletics' most magnetic personalities.
Although from the outset, Bolt appeared keen to wrap things up early.
"United is playing right now (versus City in the Manchester derby)," said the lifelong Manchester United supporter. "Very important time."
Bolt also reflected on his place in sporting history and how he hoped to be remembered, saying his ambition was never simply to dominate athletics, but to transcend it.
"My goal was always to be among the greats in sports," he said. "That when the conversation is being talked about Muhammad Ali ... and all these greats in different sports, I'm mentioned in that sentence. I'm happy that I'm actually in the conversation."
Bolt scolded reporters who had suggested at last year's world championships in Tokyo that he was out of shape.
"First of all, I made a joke and you guys took it out of context. It was everywhere!" he said. "I wasn't running out of breath walking up the stairs. I was just making a joke. I'm in the best shape of my life, guys."
His declaration drew laughter around the room.
"Listen, 'he's in the best shape of his life'. That's the headline," he said laughing before adding that he still works out daily.
Bolt flirted with a football career, but it ended in 2018 after a two-month trial with Australian club Central Coast Mariners, where he scored twice in a friendly on his first start.
But he had no answer for how his name was recently linked to Wythenshawe Vets FC, a Sunday league team in south Manchester that has gained attention for recruiting former Premier League players.
While Wythenshawe's supposed superstar signing made headlines, Bolt insisted he first learned about it when his longtime agent Ricky Simms contacted him.
"Ricky texted me and said, 'Are you playing football now?' And I was like, 'I don't know what's going on'."
Simms offered his own explanation.
"I think they wanted to have the option if he's ever in Manchester and wants to play."
And if any non-league club is still holding out hope of signing the fastest man in history, Bolt sounded in no rush to dust off his boots, preferring instead to keep an eye on Manchester United and enjoy retirement.

items.title: Haaland strike gives 10-man Man City contentious 1-0 derby win over Man United
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Erling Haaland scored in the second half to give 10-man Manchester City a 1-0 Premier League win at bitter rivals Manchester United on Sunday, with the strike initially disallowed for offside before the decision was overturned following a lengthy and contentious VAR review.
items.body:
Erling Haaland scored in the second half to give 10-man Manchester City a 1-0 Premier League win at bitter rivals Manchester United on Sunday, with the strike initially disallowed for offside before the decision was overturned following a lengthy and contentious VAR review.
The match had burst into life with the sending-off of City's Phil Foden in the 23rd minute for kicking out at Bruno Fernandes, yet it was United who ended the encounter feeling hard done by.
Haaland was flagged offside after steering Josko Gvardiol’s cross into the net from a tight angle in the 60th minute, but replays showed that Patrick Dorgu’s outstretched foot had played the Norwegian onside.
The review was prolonged by the involvement of Enzo Fernandez, who was in an offside position and launched himself at the cross without making contact. The VAR ruled the goal could stand, however, even though Fernandez's attempt appeared to affect Lisandro Martinez’s efforts to cut out the delivery.
The game simmered for the opening period before the sending-off of Foden for kicking Fernandes in the stomach from a prone position. Though the kick lacked power, it made no difference to referee Michael Oliver, who brandished the red card.
Enzo Maresca's side retreated into a compact defensive block, and initially appeared comfortable despite their numerical disadvantage, although they offered little threat going forward.
Marcus Rashford almost gave the home side the lead just before the break when Fernandez conceded a free kick outside the box, but the winger's effort struck the left-hand post.
NO OFFSIDE OFFENCE United hit the woodwork again six minutes after the restart when Kobbie Mainoo let fly from distance, but the momentum shifted on the hour as Haaland steered Gvardiol’s cross home from a tight angle.
The assistant referee’s flag cut short City’s celebrations, only for VAR to rule that Dorgu had played Haaland onside and that Fernandez’s unsuccessful attempt to reach the ball did not constitute an offside offence.
City keeper Gianluigi Donnarumma made a tremendous save in stoppage time to deny Bryan Mbeumo as City held on for a win that leaves them second in the table on 12 points from four games, behind champions Arsenal on goal difference, while United are 13th with four points from four games.
"It's a kind of new experience to win with 10 men and it's amazing, I have to be honest," Haaland told broadcaster Sky Sports.
"We need fighters in the team, which we have plenty of ... I'm super happy with every single one, and I'm so so proud of everyone ... I think we even became sharper when we became 10 men. That's how we have to play all the time, with 11 men as well."
Haaland admitted he had initially been unsure why the goal was allowed to stand.
"I think there was a flick, so I thought maybe there was someone who flicked it, because I normally don't go offside. So I told Michael Oliver I took it a bit personally that he thought it was offside," he joked.
"But I looked over to Enzo, the gaffer, and he gave me a thumbs up and then I kind of knew that it was a goal, so I prepared myself a bit to celebrate."

"But I looked over to Enzo, the gaffer, and he gave me a thumbs up and then I kind of knew that it was a goal, so I prepared myself a bit to celebrate."

items.title: Trump diz a Zelenskiy para parar de atacar diesel russo
items.author: Bo Erickson
items.creator: Bo Erickson
items.summary: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, disse neste domingo ao presidente da Ucrânia, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, que pare de atacar a infraestrutura russa de diesel, afirmando que os ataques estão causando escassez do combustível que está “prejudicando o mundo”.
items.body:
O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, disse neste domingo ao presidente da Ucrânia, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, que pare de atacar a infraestrutura russa de diesel, afirmando que os ataques estão causando escassez do combustível que está “prejudicando o mundo”.
Uma onda de ataques ucranianos com drones de longo alcance contra refinarias de petróleo russas nos últimos meses reduziu a produção de combustível da Rússia, provocando escassez de gasolina em todo o território.
A Ucrânia, que enfrenta ataques russos regulares à sua própria infraestrutura energética, afirma que as refinarias são alvos militares legítimos.
O preço médio nacional do diesel nos EUA — utilizado por caminhões, trens, navios e equipamentos agrícolas — ultrapassou US$6 por galão pela primeira vez na quinta-feira, de acordo com o site de acompanhamento de preços GasBuddy.
“O Sr. Zelenskiy precisa fazer uma coisa: ele precisa parar de destruir o estoque de diesel na Rússia”, disse Trump a jornalistas durante uma visita ao torneio de golfe Irish Open, que está sendo realizado no oeste da Irlanda, em um campo de golfe de propriedade de sua família.
“Conversamos com o Sr. Zelenskiy sobre isso. Há muitos outros alvos. Não atinjam o diesel. Isso está prejudicando o mundo”, disse ele.
A escassez global “não é causada pelo Oriente Médio, mas sim pelo que está acontecendo com a Rússia e a Ucrânia”, acrescentou Trump.
A Rússia reduziu sua previsão de produção de petróleo para este ano para o nível mais baixo em 17 anos e revisou suas perspectivas de exportação de combustível para 2026 e 2027 devido à guerra, de acordo com um rascunho de previsão do governo analisado pela Reuters.
(Reportagem de Bo Erickson)

items.summary: A non-contact left ankle injury in San Francisco's season-opening victory will keep 49ers rookie wide receiver De'Zhaun Stribling sidelined for at least a month, NFL Network reported Sunday.
items.body:
A non-contact left ankle injury in San Francisco's season-opening victory will keep 49ers rookie wide receiver De'Zhaun Stribling sidelined for at least a month, NFL Network reported Sunday.
Stribling was injured in the second quarter of the 49ers' 27-7 victory over the Los Angeles Rams on Thursday in Australia and did not return. According to the report, the injury is a deltoid ligament sprain.
The former Ole Miss star might need to have surgery, per the report, but it had not been determined as of Sunday morning.
After the game, head coach Kyle Shanahan said that the rookie's Achilles was intact, but that more tests were required to determine the exact nature of the injury.
The 49ers chose Stribling, 23, with the first pick of the second round (No. 33 overall) in the 2026 NFL Draft. The Hawaii native earned more playing time after impressing the team at training camp.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Rusia ataca un tren de pasajeros en frontera de Ucrania con Polonia, no alcanza a "tren diplomático"
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Un dron ruso impactó el domingo contra un tren de pasajeros en la frontera de Ucrania con Polonia, país miembro de la OTAN, poco después de que el ex primer ministro británico Boris Johnson y otros diplomáticos europeos utilizaron la misma línea.
items.body:
Un dron ruso impactó el domingo contra un tren de pasajeros en la frontera de Ucrania con Polonia, país miembro de la OTAN, poco después de que el ex primer ministro británico Boris Johnson y otros diplomáticos europeos utilizaron la misma línea.
El tren, que circulaba por una ruta muy utilizada por las delegaciones extranjeras que regresan de Kiev, fue atacado a solo 2 kilómetros (1,2 millas) de la frontera polaca, informó la empresa ferroviaria ucraniana.
No se han registrado víctimas.
"No era nuestro tren, sino el que iba unos minutos detrás de nosotros por el paso fronterizo. Se evacuó cuando se acercó el dron y nadie resultó herido", dijo Carl Bildt, ex primer ministro de Suecia, en X.
Él y otros políticos regresaban a Europa en tren tras asistir a una conferencia en Kiev.
"Es muy posible que el objetivo del dron ruso fuera el tren diplomático, que salió de la estación antes de lo previsto tras ajustarse los horarios de los trenes en tiempo real debido a la amenaza constante de ataques rusos", dijo en Telegram la empresa ferroviaria ucraniana, Ukrzaliznytsia.
Boris Johnson, que también se encontraba en el tren que salió de la estación poco antes del ataque, condenó este como "aleatorio y sin sentido" en una publicación en Instagram.
Dado que la línea del frente se mantiene prácticamente estática, tanto Moscú como Kiev han intensificado los ataques a larga distancia en las últimas semanas para intentar cambiar el rumbo de la guerra.
El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores polaco, Radoslaw Sikorski, calificó los crecientes ataques de Rusia a las puertas de la OTAN como "una escalada".
El domingo por la mañana, un camión situado a menos de 1 km de la frontera de Ucrania con Polonia también fue alcanzado, lo que provocó que el paso fronterizo de Dorohusk-Yahodyn suspendiera brevemente sus operaciones, según los guardias fronterizos.
El Ministerio de Defensa ruso dijo que había atacado infraestructuras que facilitaban el transporte de cargamentos militares procedentes de Europa en el oeste de Ucrania.
Rusia ha comenzado a atacar en las últimas semanas los pasos fronterizos de Ucrania con sus aliados occidentales, como parte de una campaña cada vez más intensa por ambas partes para debilitar la infraestructura económica del adversario, cuando ya se han cumplido más de cuatro años desde el inicio de la invasión rusa.
RUSIA REPORTA ATAQUE CERCA DE CENTRAL NUCLEAR DE ZAPORIYIA Durante la noche, las hostilidades no dieron señales de amainar.
En la parte controlada por Rusia de la región de Zaporiyia, al sureste de Ucrania, el director de Rosatom, la empresa estatal rusa de energía nuclear, acusó a Ucrania de atacar camiones de combustible cerca de la central nuclear de Zaporiyia, la mayor de Europa.
La central nuclear de Zaporiyia está bajo control ruso desde marzo de 2022 y sigue situada cerca de la línea del frente. Un portavoz militar ucraniano no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios.
En la propia Rusia, el alcalde de la ciudad de Nizhnekamsk, en la región del río Volga, en Tartaristán, afirmó que objetivos "civiles e industriales" de la ciudad habían sido atacados por drones ucranianos, lo que provocó al menos dos muertos y varios heridos más.
El alcalde, Radmir Belyaev, no aclaró qué objetivos habían sido alcanzados, pero la ciudad alberga una importante refinería de petróleo que ya ha sido objeto de ataques en el pasado.
Las autoridades ucranianas no se pronunciaron de inmediato sobre el ataque a Nizhnekamsk, pero sí dijeron que habían atacado otra refinería en la región meridional de Krasnodar.

items.title: Team Europe jolts Americans, reclaims Solheim Cup
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Team Europe regained the Solheim Cup with a 15-13 victory over the United States on Sunday in Den Bosch, Netherlands.
items.body:
Team Europe regained the Solheim Cup with a 15-13 victory over the United States on Sunday in Den Bosch, Netherlands.
Lottie Woad sank a 2-foot putt on the 17th hole to record a 2&1 win over Auston Kim, pushing the Europeans past the 14 1/2-point threshold at Bernardus Golf. That included Carlota Ciganda's guaranteed half point in her match.
The successful putt ignited a celebration that featured Woad leaping into the arms of her teammates as Europe reveled in its eighth win in the event and avenged the United States' victory in 2024.
Woad admitted she wasn't sure if it was her match or that of Carlota Ciganda that ultimately would cement the victory for Team Europe.
"I knew it was mine or Carlota's match," Woad said. "And when Auston made those three birdies in a row that was great golf from her and I just had to try and stay steady, and the moment on 16 was a key one, definitely."
Ciganda sealed the win with a 4-and-2 victory over Jennifer Kupcho, who sank a 93-foot putt to upend Ciganda on Saturday.
"I think it's been one of the best teams that we've had in the last few years," Ciganda said. "Everyone is just a unit, a team. That's what Europe is about."
The teams were locked in an 8-8 tie before Europe bolted out of the blocks by winning six of Sunday's first eight matches, save for Alison Lee rallying from four down after 11 holes to notch a 1 up win over Esther Henseleit.
That represented the biggest comeback in a singles competition in Solheim Cup history.
"Huge," Lee said of securing the victory. "I definitely kept an eye on the leaderboard the whole round. I did see a lot of blue up there, but I just did the best I can to change mine red and thankfully I was able to pull it off."
--Field Level Media

items.title: Trump reiterates support for united Ireland, says won't talk about Scotland 'yet'
items.author: Bo Erickson, Padraic Halpin
items.creator: Bo Erickson, Padraic Halpin
items.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump on Sunday reiterated his support for Northern Ireland breaking from the United Kingdom to unify with the Republic of Ireland, but said he would not talk about Scotland becoming independent "yet".
items.body:
U.S. President Donald Trump on Sunday reiterated his support for Northern Ireland breaking from the United Kingdom to unify with the Republic of Ireland, but said he would not talk about Scotland becoming independent "yet".
Trump surprised officials in Dublin and annoyed pro-British politicians in Northern Ireland and London by enthusiastically[USN:L6N454021 TEXT:" backing"] Irish unity during a visit to Dublin on Saturday, saying he would "love" to see it happen sooner rather than later.
"You have Northern Ireland and you have Ireland and it would seem to me that one of the 'naturals' of all time is to put them together," Trump told reporters during a visit to a golf tournament at one of his resorts, doubling down on his initial comments.
"You asked about Scotland. That one I won't talk about yet. I'll save that for another day," he added.
Scotland, where the Trump family also owns a golf resort, voted against independence from the rest of Britain in 2014. British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has [USN:SPN43N00V TEXT:"ruled out"] another vote, as well as a referendum on Northern Ireland leaving the UK.
Trump made his comments about Irish unity after a meeting with Micheal Martin, the country's prime minister. In his first comments since Trump's remarks, the Irish premier said the response from some unionist politicians was "an overreaction".
"It shouldn't be a surprise. He takes a different sort of perspective on things," Martin told reporters on Sunday after meeting Trump again for lunch at the golf course.
Martin said the pair discussed Northern Ireland and its relationship with the Republic of Ireland and that he also went through with the president how the British-run region achieved peace.
A 1998 peace agreement ended three decades of violence between Irish nationalists seeking a united Ireland and unionists who wanted Northern Ireland to remain part of the UK.
"I support unity, I don't see it happening now. I've been very clear about that," Martin told BBC News in a separate interview.
"The chances are if one (vote) was held next week, it would find great difficulty in getting through."
